positive_snippets:
I had a really comfortable stay at Gold Residency. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and the overall atmosphere felt calm and welcoming. What truly stood out was the hospitality of the staff.

Special mention to Virendra — he was extremely polite, helpful, and always available whenever I needed assistance. His behavior made the stay feel smooth and hassle-free.

If you’re looking for a decent place to stay in Delhi with supportive staff and good service, this hotel is definitely worth considering.
negative_snippets:
I stayed at this hotel, and the experience was extremely disappointing. The room was not clean at all—used tissues were found under the bed, and the bed and furniture were dirty. The bathroom taps were leaking, which made the bathroom uncomfortable to use.

Room service was very poor. I ordered a water bottle, but it was not delivered even after waiting for hours. I had to ask three times, and still, no one responded properly. The staff’s behavior was rude and unhelpful.

We paid ₹6,056 for two days, and it was absolutely not worth the money. The hotel looks good in photos, but the reality is very different. I would strongly recommend never staying at this hotel.

High probability of SCAM!!! The hotel is fine, you get everything, but not for the price you find on booking.com or other sites. The actual price is around 5000+ rupees. The hotel manager almost cheated me. I had a reservation from booking.com for 1,300 rupees, but when I arrived, they wanted four times the price, about 5,000 rupees!!!

After we argued with the manager, he tried to prove to me that it wasn't the same hotel I had booked through Booking.com. The address and contact number were different. He couldn't accept the price from the reservation, and I had to pay more.
